taskNotes: Crawling Hands require 5 Slayer and Priest in Peril (for Slayer Tower access) to be assigned by Turael, Spria, or Mazchna.
slayerTargetId 285 is SYNTHETIC (c2-c3-worklist section 1 allocation contract); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
All Crawling Hand variants share 15 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush), 4-tick attack speed, and Defence level 3.
Crawling Hands are undead: the salve amulet and Crumble Undead both apply.
They have no elemental weakness; any melee weapon clears them trivially.
No required protective item and no task extension unlock exist for Crawling Hands.
recommendedMethod: A trivial starter task: kill the ground-floor Crawling Hands with any melee weapon. They have max hit 1 and 15 Hitpoints, so no protection prayers or special gear are needed; a salve amulet gives a small undead damage bonus.
